content.content: While any open draft record names the node, the deccy CLI shall refuse to remove that node, naming each such draft by its handle.
content.rationale:
The sentence is the guard tzlumxvt fixes, written in the constrained grammar: a state-driven requirement whose trigger is the record's state and whose response is the refusal. Every element is taken from one of the four prerequisites rather than chosen here.

The trigger, `While any open draft record names the node`, is two prerequisites at once. `open` is vkkwusty's value for the record of a draft that has not landed, the not-landed side of the pair that exhausts the landing question; the sentence therefore attaches to a record's state rather than to the act of opening one, and because `landed` is the only transition out of `open`, the condition stops holding when the draft lands and not before. `a draft record names the node` is owyntkvw's reference: a record names exactly one target node, so the trigger is a comparison per record against the id the caller gave `deccy remove <id>` (stnqmzuw), and it is the record — keyed by its handle, outside the node space, not a node and not a change — that is asked (owyntkvw). `any` carries owyntkvw's many-ness across records rather than inside one: one node may be named by several records at once, so the condition is satisfied by any one of them and the sentence does not single one out.

The response, `the deccy CLI shall refuse to remove that node`, is stnqmzuw's refusal shape: removal refuses when a precondition fails, and `that node` is the id the caller named to `deccy remove <id>`. tzlumxvt places this as one more condition on that same refusal surface, so the refusal stated here is the kind D14 already gives a node that something depends on, with the open drafts where the dependants were; which of the refusals is asked first, and the scan that finds the records at all, are tzlumxvt's and are not restated here.

`naming each such draft by its handle` is owyntkvw's identity read back to the caller: the handle is minted for the draft and is the only thing that picks a record out, so it is what a refusal can name, and it is also the only thing that tells the several drafts of one node apart — the node id cannot, because every one of them names it (owyntkvw). `each` keeps the naming one name per blocking record, as `any` kept the trigger one record among many. tzlumxvt already fixes that the refusal names each such draft by its handle; the sentence states that duty and adds nothing to it.

Deliberately not here: that a landed record does not block, which is tzlumxvt's exclusion and is absent from the sentence because the trigger names only vkkwusty's `open` value; the directory the records are read from, the scan over it, and the placement of the guard before anything is abandoned, all of which tzlumxvt settles; and how a refusal's lines are worded and rendered, which belongs to the envelope rather than to the guard (tzlumxvt). This node decides only the requirement sentence; it licenses no artefact and fixes no command surface beyond the verb stnqmzuw already defines.
